Overview

The Macle Mini Program supports customized internationalization. Currently, the following languages are supported: Burmese, Urdu, English, Chinese, Amharic, Afan Oromo, and Tigirigna.

The macle-i18n usage is divided into three parts. They are: i18n text definition, usage in MAML, and usage in JavaScript. The macle-i18n requires no installation or build.

Use

i18n Text

The macle-i18n uses a JSON file to define the I18n text. Before the I18n text is used, the I18n directory needs to be created in the project source file.

The directory structure is as follows:

└── src                // Directory of the source file of the Mini Program
|   ├── app.js
|   ├── app.json
|   ├── app.mass
|   ├── i18n           // Directory of the I18n text
|   |   ├── en-US.json
|   |   └── zh-CN.json

The JSON file name is in the format of Languag-Country, for example, zh-CN.

The I18n directory can be placed in any position in the source file directory. For example, the I18n directory can be placed together with the Page or Component directory. Files in multiple I18n directories are combined and packed during construction. Therefore, if the translated text has duplicate keys, the files may be overwritten. If multiple I18n directories are defined, ensure that the key is globally unique. For example, you can name a key page.index.testKey.

Example:


// i18n/zh-CN.json
{
  "plainText": "这是一段纯文本",
  "withParams": "你传入的值是{value}"
}

// i18n/en-US.json
{
  "plainText": "This is a plain text",
  "withParams": "{value} is what you pass in"
}

Usage in MAML

After the I18n text is defined, it can be used in the MAML file.

<!-- pages/index/index.maml -->
<view>{{ i18n.t('plainText') }}</view>
<input placeholder="{{ i18n.t('withParams', {value}) }}"></input>

Use the i18n.t function in MAML to obtain text. The signature of the t function is as follows:

t(key: string, params: object)

It contains two parameters: key, which is from the I18n text, and the interpolation object to be transferred, which can be transferred from the AppService.

Use the i18n.getLocale function in MAML to obtain the current language.

<!-- pages/index/index.maml -->
<view>{{ i18n.getLocale() }}</view>

Note: The default module name of macle-i18n is i18n. You can customize the module name. For details, see the following description:

Customize the macle-i18n module name, which can be implemented by importing SJS to the MAML file.

<sjs module="customi18nModule" src="i18n.sjs" />

// i18n.sjs
function t(str, arr) {
  return i18n.t(str, arr);
}
function getLocale(str, arr) {
  return i18n.getLocale(str, arr);
}
module.exports = {
  t: t,
  getLocale: getLocale
};

Use SJS in the MAML file with the custom module.

<!-- pages/index/index.maml -->
<view>{{ customi18nModule.t('plainText') }}</view>
<input placeholder="{{ customi18nModule.t('withParams', {value}) }}"></input>
<view>{{ customi18nModule.getLocale() }}</view>

Usage in JavaScript

  1. Access through the I18n instance in Page/Component.
const i18n = getI18nInstance();
Page({
  onLoad() {
    const text = i18n.t('withParams', { value: 'Test' });
    console.log(text); // Test is what you pass in
    i18n.setLocale('en-US');
  }
});

Other APIs are available on the I18n instance, for example, the API for obtaining the current language and the API for dynamically setting the current language. For details, see Interface Document.

  1. If the I18n instance is unavailable, use I18nPage to replace the Page constructor and use this to invoke it.
I18nPage({
  onLoad() {
    const text = this.t('withParams', { value: 'Test' });
    console.log(text); // Test is what you pass in
    this.setLocale('en-US');
  }
});

Characteristic

Currently, macle-i18n supports only plain text and text interpolation.

Text Interpolation

{
  "key": "Inserted value: {value}"
}

i18n.t('key', { value: 'Hello!' })  // Inserted value: Hello!

To invoke deeply nested objects, the dot syntax can be used in JavaScript to access object attributes.

{
  "dotted": "Nested value is: { obj.nested.value }"
}

const value = {
  obj: {
    nested: {
      value: 'Catch you!'
    }
  }
}
i18n.t('dotted', value)  // Nested value is: Catch you!

select Statement

// i18n/en-US.json
{
  "key": "{gender, select, male {His inbox} female {Her inbox} other {Their inbox}}"
}

// i18n/zh-CN.json
{
  "key": "{gender, select, male {他} female {她} other {其他}}"
}

// en-US
i18n.t('key', { gender: 'male' })    // His inbox
i18n.t('key', { gender: 'female' })  // Her inbox
i18n.t('key')                        // Their inbox
// zh-CN
i18n.t('key', { gender: 'male' })    // 他
i18n.t('key', { gender: 'female' })  // 她
i18n.t('key')                        // 其他

The select statement supports substatement text interpolation.

// i18n/en-US.json
{
  "key": "{mood, select, good {{how} day!} sad {{how} day.} other {Whatever!}}"
}
// i18n/zh-CN.json
{
  "key": "{mood, select, good {{how}天气!} sad {{how}天气.} other {其他!}}"
}

// en-US
i18n.t('key', { mood: 'good', how: 'Awesome'  })  // Awesome day!
i18n.t('key', { mood: 'sad', how: 'Unhappy'  })   // Unhappy day.
i18n.t('key')                                     // Whatever!
// zh-CN
i18n.t('key', { mood: 'good', how: '好'  })  // 好天气!
i18n.t('key', { mood: 'sad', how: '不好'  })   // 坏天气.
i18n.t('key')                                     // 其他!
